title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at Hays Information Technology (ACT, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Data Analyst required for a 12 month contract in Canberra Your new company You will be working for a large Federal Government Department Your new role You will be creating data reports and manipulating large data sets to provide evidence towards policy formulation. You will be assisting in the construction of statistical data models and be required to liaise with several key business stakeholders. What you'll need to succeed Experience in SAS programming (BASE and EG). Experience in manipulating and extracting data from large data sets. Experience with Data Linkage would be an advantage. Experience in statistical or data modelling would be an advantage. Experience in R, Teradata and machine learning techniques would be desirable. You must have strong communication and stakeholder liaison abilities. What you'll get in return An initial 12 month contract, attractive hourly rates and the opportunity to work on an exciting data program are on offer for the right candidate. What you need to do now If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV. Call Liam O'Meara on 02 62579802 or email Liam.omeara@hays.com.au for any questions relating to this role.
